translations.web: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
translations.kjv: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
translations.asv: Happy is the people that is in such a case; Yea, happy is the people whose God is Jehovah. Psalm 145 A Psalm of praise; of David.
